since it's been up since June and not getting much traction

This filename should be entity_manager/utils.cpp, right?

The test structure should mirror the code structure.
Agree. Might have to abandon / rework this one. WIP for now.
Done
ok, i'm lost, what is this doing?

Array of which tests to build.

Alternative here would be to just declare a single test but most of the lines for declaring a test are repeated for each test binary.

So i just went with the loop there to avoid having to do this change later on when other tests are added for `src/entity_manager`.

It makes more sense in the new revision, since the toplogy test also needs moving as you mentioned in the other comment 😊
Shouldn't this move into test/entity_manager/ since topology.cpp is in src/entity_manager/?
Yes.. thanks for pointing it out 😊. New revision has this change.

This loop implies that all things link against all dependencies.  I'd like to keep this as an explicit list to make sure that tests that don't have a dependence on say, nlohmann, don't require it on accident.

Makes sense to me, we can follow the fine-grained approach.
Changed it to list the dependencies for each test inline.

Also changed it in
- test/fru_device
- test/gpio_presence

to put the fine grained dependencies.
Do we know why this got registered as a delete then add rather than a file move?  that's going to mess up the git log --follow history.

There is another rename

test/entity_manager/test_entity-manager.cpp -> test/utils.cpp

which contains tests like `TEST(IfindFirstTest, BasicMatch)` now.

I assume as per file renaming semantics, we cannot have 2 files renamed to one file.

> that's going to mess up the git log --follow history.

Yes but mirroring `src/` directory structure in `test/` folder helps to make sure we will be able to avoid this issue in the future.

We are solving an issue with a number of files here, if a single (test) file has a problem now with it's history, i consider it an acceptable tradeoff.

If you consider the history to be a greater priority, let me know and i can exclude the file from this restructuring.
